question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: Resolves on AMD Q3 2026 revenue, which AMD reports Nov 3, 2026. AMD guided $13.0B ± $0.3B. Street estimate is ~$13.19B. Reference class: AMD's actual revenue vs its own guidance midpoint. Q2'26 beat by 3.0% ($11.536B vs $11.2B); recalled earlier quarters beat by ~4-7%. AMD has rarely missed its midpoint in recent years. Median ~$13.39B (≈+3% beat). Left tail allows for data-center ramp slippage or weak gaming. Right tail allows for an MI-series pull-in. No Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market found.

- Resolves off AMD's reported Q3 2026 (fiscal quarter ending ~late Sep 2026) total revenue; AMD reports Tue Nov 3, 2026 after market close (AMD IR / StockTitan). The Nov 3 release date is later than the question's scheduled resolution of Oct 29.
- Event window: Q3 FY2026 quarter (Jul-Sep 2026) -> reported Nov 3, 2026; as of Oct 11 the quarter is complete and results are not yet public.
- AMD Q3 2026 guidance (Aug 4, 2026 press release): ~$13.0B ± $0.3B, ~41% YoY, ~13% QoQ, non-GAAP GM ~56%.
- Street consensus Q3 2026 revenue ~$13.19B, EPS ~$1.95 (Tradingpedia, Oct 5, 2026). Prior consensus before guidance was ~$12.5B.
- Q2 2026 actual: $11.536B (+50% YoY, +13% QoQ) vs guidance $11.2B ± $0.3B (+3.0% above midpoint) vs consensus $11.25B. Data Center $6.718B (+107% YoY), Client $3.062B (+23%), Gaming $0.779B (-31%), Embedded $0.977B (+19%).
- Q2 2026 gross margin missed (54% vs 56% expected) on Helios rack ramp costs; stock fell ~8% after hours.
- Historical surprise vs guidance midpoint (from memory, not re-verified): Q1'25 ~+4.8% (7.44 vs 7.1), Q2'25 ~+3.9% (7.685 vs 7.4), Q3'25 ~+6% (9.25 vs 8.7), Q4'25 ~+7% (10.27 vs 9.6); Q2'26 +3.0% (verified). No below-midpoint quarter in this set.
- Risks to the downside: Helios/MI-series ramp timing, gaming decline, export-control shocks (2025 MI308 $800M charge precedent). Risks to the upside: AI GPU pull-ins, client CPU share gains.
- Market search: no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi contract found.
- Searched but not found: Q3 pre-announcement or guidance revision (none found).

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to $13.0B +/- $0.3B (Aug 4, 2026); consensus ~$13.19B. Reference class: AMD's actual revenue vs its guidance midpoint, with beats every recent quarter of about +2-7% (mean ~4%, SD ~2%). Q2'26 beat by only +3.0% and the Helios rack ramp is lumpy, so I centre on roughly a +3.2% beat, giving a median of ~$13.42B. The left tail covers rack/MI450 shipment slips, a steeper gaming decline or export controls; the right tail covers AI GPU pull-ins. No human prediction market was found by the runs (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold); I could not re-check. Report due Nov 3, 2026.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the guidance ($13.0B +/- $0.3B), consensus ($13.19B), the Q2'26 actual ($11.536B, +3.0% vs midpoint; Run 3's +2.7% comes from rounding to $11.5B) and the Nov 3 report date. There were no factual conflicts. The 2025 beat history is from memory in every run but is consistent across them. The remaining disagreement is judgment: how large a beat to centre on (+3% to +3.6%). I weighted the recent smaller beat and ramp-cost signals against the longer ~4% mean. I kept a width similar to Run 1's because it reflects the beat SD plus tail risk; Runs 2 and 3 are slightly too tight given rack lumpiness. Escape probability past either bound is ~1% or less, so no escape mass is declared.

disagreements.verdict: Settled: $11.536B vs $11.2B = +3.0%; +2.7% used the rounded $11.5B. Immaterial.
Took ~+3.2%: the long-run mean is ~4%, but the latest beat was smaller and the Helios ramp is lumpy.
Used ~$0.76B: beat SD x 2.56 plus tail risk from rack timing and export controls.
